title: Sabato sancto. Lectio secunda (Gaspar, Lamentatio Ieremiae prophetae)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Lamentatio Ieremiae prophetae, Sabato sancto. Lectio secunda. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0501e), edited by Agnese Pavanello (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. V. Settings of Liturgical Texts, Songs, and Instrumental Works, 2020); encoded by Karina Zybina. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 2018, Pavanello, Agnese. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
